project.title: Activated sludge from partial denitrification reactor fed with ferrous iron and sodium acetate Raw sequence reads
project.description: This BioSample submission contains six 16S rRNA gene (V3-V4) amplicon sequencing samples from activated sludge of a lab-scale partial denitrification reactor fed with ferrous iron and sodium acetate. Sludge samples were collected at different operation phrases (phrase 0, I, II 1-3, and III) to investigate temporal dynamics of the microbial community.
